description.text: The Japanese Gym deck of Brock, Pewter City's Gym Leader, sold as ポケモンジム第1弾「ニビシティジム タケシ」 (Pokémon Gym 1: Nivi City Gym, Takeshi) on 26 April 1998 with Misty's deck, the first two of six. Its 64 cards are 25 different ones: Brock's own Pokémon, Brock as a holo Trainer, a holo Brock's Rhydon, the Pewter City Gym stadium, new Trainers, and reworded copies of older Trainers that the decks share. The cards carry the Gym series' symbol, as Leader's Stadium's and Challenge from the Darkness's do, but no card number or rarity mark. Leader's Stadium reprinted many of them with a rarity mark, and English players got them in Gym Heroes; the deck was the model for the English Brock theme deck. Besides his Fighting-type Pokémon it has the Vulpix and Zubat Brock uses in the anime. Its fixed rarities made Brock's Onix, Rhyhorn, Sandslash and Zubat four of Gym Heroes' "common rares" when the cards came to English. It came with a rule book, counters and a brown Onix coin.
